phoneticConvention: Approximate English respelling for English-speaking readers (CAPITALS = stressed syllable; vowels ah / eh / ee / oh / oo; j and g before e/i → kh as in Scottish 'loch'; ñ → ny; ll → y; c before e/i and z → s; r is rolled; monosyllables in capitals). Standard Castilian with seseo and yeísmo. No substitute for the audio.
reviewStatus: Written by rule from validated content; native English review recommended.
title: Explaining and comparing
goal: Explain a reason, compare and express a preference.

model.note: 'porque' (one word, no accent) = because; '¿por qué?' = why.

units.situation: Giving a reason for a preference

variants.study: Prefiero el mercado porque es más barato.

variants.study: Prefiero cocinar en casa porque es más barato.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: ¿Qué te parece este restaurante?
turns.phon: KEH TEH pah-REH-seh EHS-teh rehs-tahoo-RAHN-teh
turns.native: What do you think of this restaurant?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Me parece muy bueno, pero un poco caro.
turns.phon: MEH pah-REH-seh MOOEE BOOEH-noh, PEH-roh OON POH-koh KAH-roh
turns.native: I think it's very good, but a bit expensive.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: ¿Qué vas a pedir?
turns.phon: KEH VAHS AH peh-DEER
turns.native: What are you going to order?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: El pescado. Me gusta más el pescado que la carne.
turns.phon: EHL pehs-KAH-doh. MEH GOOS-tah MAHS EHL pehs-KAH-doh KEH LAH KAHR-neh
turns.native: The fish. I like fish better than meat.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Yo prefiero la paella porque es más típica.
turns.phon: YOH preh-FEEEH-roh LAH pah-EH-yah POHR-keh EHS MAHS TEE-pee-kah
turns.native: I prefer the paella because it's more typical.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Buena idea. ¿Y de beber?
turns.phon: BOOEH-nah ee-DEH-ah. EE DEH beh-BEHR
turns.native: Good idea. And to drink?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Para mí, agua. Antes bebía vino en la comida, ahora ya no.
turns.phon: PAH-rah MEE, AH-gooah. AHN-tehs beh-BEE-ah VEE-noh EHN LAH koh-MEE-dah, ah-OH-rah YAH NOH
turns.native: For me, water. I used to drink wine at lunch, but not any more.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Yo también bebo menos que antes.
turns.phon: YOH tahm-BEEEHN BEH-boh MEH-nohs KEH AHN-tehs
turns.native: I drink less than before too.

dialogues.situation: Working from home or at the office

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: ¿Trabajas desde casa?
turns.phon: trah-BAH-khahs DEHS-deh KAH-sah
turns.native: Do you work from home?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Sí, tres días por semana. Para mí, es más práctico.
turns.phon: SEE, TREHS DEE-ahs POHR seh-MAH-nah. PAH-rah MEE, EHS MAHS PRAHK-tee-koh
turns.native: Yes, three days a week. For me, it's more practical.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: ¿Por qué?
turns.phon: POHR KEH
turns.native: Why?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Es que pierdo menos tiempo en el transporte y estoy más tranquilo.
turns.phon: EHS KEH PEEEHR-doh MEH-nohs TEEEHM-poh EHN EHL trahns-POHR-teh EE ehs-TOHEE MAHS trahn-KEE-loh
turns.native: It's just that I waste less time commuting and I'm more relaxed.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Yo prefiero ir a la oficina porque veo a mis compañeros.
turns.phon: YOH preh-FEEEH-roh EER AH LAH oh-fee-SEE-nah POHR-keh VEH-oh AH MEES kohm-pah-NYEH-rohs
turns.native: I prefer going to the office because I see my colleagues.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Te entiendo. Lo bueno es que ahora podemos elegir.
turns.phon: TEH ehn-TEEEHN-doh. LOH BOOEH-noh EHS KEH ah-OH-rah poh-DEH-mohs eh-leh-KHEER
turns.native: I understand. The good thing is that now we can choose.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Antes trabajaba todos los días en la oficina y llegaba a casa muy tarde.
turns.phon: AHN-tehs trah-bah-KHAH-bah TOH-dohs LOHS DEE-ahs EHN LAH oh-fee-SEE-nah EE yeh-GAH-bah AH KAH-sah MOOEE TAHR-deh
turns.native: I used to work at the office every day and I got home very late.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Ahora descansas más que antes, ¿no?
turns.phon: ah-OH-rah dehs-KAHN-sahs MAHS KEH AHN-tehs, NOH
turns.native: Now you rest more than before, don't you?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Sí, mucho más.
turns.phon: SEE, MOO-choh MAHS
turns.native: Yes, much more.

readiness: Justify a choice (porque, es que), compare (más / menos… que, mejor), give a simple opinion (creo que, me parece, para mí) and describe a past habit in the imperfect to explain a change.
